remarks: Timeless New England Colonial on 1.3 acres blending historic architecture with modern updates. Built in 1860 and reimagined by designer Dan Barsanti with curated interiors by Rena Levine, this five-bedroom, five-bath residence features refined millwork, wide-plank floors, and bespoke lighting. The open main level includes a bright kitchen with premium appliances, dining area, and living room with French doors to a bluestone patio and heated pool. A first-floor suite provides flexible guest or office space; the upper level hosts a spacious primary suite, marble bath, and dressing area. Systems include upgraded HVAC, EV-ready garage, and smart-home controls. Set on 1.3 acres with mature landscaping and a fenced backyard. Just 1 mi to Compo Beach, 0.9 mi to Longshore Golf Club, 1.0 mi to Levitt Pavilion, and 1.1 mi to Downtown Westport shops and dining. Offered furnished with curated designer pieces for a move-in experience rarely available in Westport.
